parameters.query:
WITH b AS (
  SELECT d,
         (d::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Dhaka') AS s,
         ((d + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Dhaka') AS e
  FROM (SELECT ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Dhaka')::date - 1) AS d) x
)
SELECT
  b.d::text AS report_date,
  (SELECT count(*)::int FROM messages m WHERE m.direction = 'inbound' AND m.created_at >= b.s AND m.created_at < b.e) AS inbound_messages,
  (SELECT count(DISTINCT m.conversation_id)::int FROM messages m WHERE m.direction = 'inbound' AND m.created_at >= b.s AND m.created_at < b.e) AS active_conversations,
  (SELECT count(*)::int FROM messages m WHERE m.direction = 'outbound' AND m.processing_status = 'sent' AND coalesce(m.intent, '') NOT LIKE 'comment\_%' AND m.created_at >= b.s AND m.created_at < b.e) AS replies_sent,
  (SELECT count(*)::int FROM messages m WHERE m.processing_status = 'failed' AND m.created_at >= b.s AND m.created_at < b.e) AS failed_messages,
  (SELECT count(*)::int FROM messages m WHERE m.processing_status = 'escalated' AND m.created_at >= b.s AND m.created_at < b.e) AS escalated_to_human,
  (SELECT count(*)::int FROM messages m WHERE m.intent LIKE 'comment\_%' AND m.created_at >= b.s AND m.created_at < b.e) AS comments_handled,
  (SELECT count(*)::int FROM customers c WHERE c.created_at >= b.s AND c.created_at < b.e) AS new_customers,
  (SELECT count(*)::int FROM orders o WHERE o.confirmed_at >= b.s AND o.confirmed_at < b.e AND o.order_status <> 'cancelled') AS orders_confirmed,
  (SELECT coalesce(sum(o.total_bdt), 0)::float8 FROM orders o WHERE o.confirmed_at >= b.s AND o.confirmed_at < b.e AND o.order_status <> 'cancelled') AS confirmed_order_value_bdt,
  (SELECT count(*)::int FROM orders o WHERE o.confirmed_at >= b.s AND o.confirmed_at < b.e AND o.order_status <> 'cancelled' AND o.payment_status = 'pending') AS orders_payment_pending,
  (SELECT coalesce(sum(o.total_bdt), 0)::float8 FROM orders o WHERE o.confirmed_at >= b.s AND o.confirmed_at < b.e AND o.order_status <> 'cancelled' AND o.payment_status = 'paid') AS payments_received_bdt,
  (SELECT count(*)::int FROM orders o WHERE o.order_status = 'cancelled' AND o.updated_at >= b.s AND o.updated_at < b.e) AS orders_cancelled,
  (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(t), '[]'::json) FROM (
     SELECT oi.product_name_snapshot AS name, sum(oi.quantity)::int AS qty
     FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
     WHERE o.confirmed_at >= b.s AND o.confirmed_at < b.e AND o.order_status <> 'cancelled'
     GROUP BY oi.product_name_snapshot ORDER BY sum(oi.quantity) DESC, oi.product_name_snapshot LIMIT 3) t) AS top_products,
  (SELECT count(*)::int FROM content_queue q WHERE q.status = 'published' AND q.published_at >= b.s AND q.published_at < b.e) AS posts_published,
  (SELECT count(*)::int FROM content_queue q WHERE q.status = 'failed' AND q.created_at >= b.s AND q.created_at < b.e) AS posts_failed,
  (SELECT count(*)::int FROM content_queue q WHERE q.status = 'review') AS drafts_awaiting_review,
  (SELECT count(*)::int FROM workflow_errors w WHERE w.created_at >= b.s AND w.created_at < b.e) AS workflow_errors,
  (SELECT count(*)::int FROM workflow_errors w WHERE w.resolved_at IS NULL) AS unresolved_errors,
  (SELECT count(*)::int FROM webhook_events we WHERE we.processing_status = 'failed' AND we.received_at >= b.s AND we.received_at < b.e) AS failed_webhook_events,
  (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(t), '[]'::json) FROM (
     SELECT p.product_name AS name, p.stock_quantity AS stock
     FROM products p WHERE p.active AND p.stock_quantity <= 5
     ORDER BY p.stock_quantity, p.product_name LIMIT 5) t) AS low_stock
FROM b

INSERT INTO daily_reports (report_date, metrics, report_text, notification_status)
VALUES ($1::date, $2::jsonb, $3, 'pending')
ON CONFLICT (report_date) DO UPDATE
  SET metrics = EXCLUDED.metrics, report_text = EXCLUDED.report_text
  WHERE daily_reports.notification_status <> 'sent'
RETURNING report_id, report_date::text AS report_date, report_text
UPDATE daily_reports SET notification_status = 'sent' WHERE report_id = $1 RETURNING report_id, notification_status
UPDATE daily_reports SET notification_status = 'failed' WHERE report_id = $1 RETURNING report_id, notification_status

parameters.content: WF06 - Daily report. Runs 21:00 Asia/Dhaka and reports the PREVIOUS completed calendar day (Dhaka time). Read-only on business data; writes only daily_reports. A day already marked sent is never re-sent. Needs: Postgres credential, Telegram credential, n8n variable ADMIN_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID. Confirmed COD orders are shown as payment pending, never as payments received.
